## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a polished 3D Warcraft-style RTS browser game with three playable races (Alliance, Horde, Undead) in the empty repo `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`.

## Requirements
- 3D RTS in Warcraft style with three races; user request is in Russian, so UI/content is Russian.
- Repo had no game files initially; must produce a static playable web game with `index.html` served by the provided runtime.
- Project guidance (separate from user): support desktop and mobile/touch controls, test via `playwright-cli` with screenshots, reject blank/loading-screen captures, and note SwiftShader if used.

## Decisions
- Single-page static HTML/JS app using vendored Three.js (`vendor/three.module.js`); root `package.json`/lock removed so runtime detects the `html` project type.
- No external art/audio assets: procedural low-poly models, canvas terrain/minimap, procedural WebAudio SFX.
- Gameplay: 1v1 duel vs AI, race choice + difficulty, economy (gold/lumber/supply), buildings, units, combat, caster heals, neutral healing fountain, rich central gold mine, control groups, rally points, production queues, win by destroying all enemy halls.
- Architecture split into small modules: data, map, nav, entities, game, combat, AI, render/views, effects, world, UI, input, audio, showcase, main.

## Work State
### Completed
- Vendored Three.js: `vendor/three.module.js` (copied from three@0.170.0; `node_modules` remains but is gitignored).
- Implemented data definitions for all three races, units/buildings/stats/costs/difficulties (`js/data.js`).
- Implemented map constants/layout generation (`js/map.js`), procedural terrain/world/lighting/pond/mountains/clouds/grass (`js/world.js`), nav grid + A* + smoothing (`js/nav.js`).
- Implemented procedural models: shared materials, all 15 unit models, all 15 building models, trees/rocks/gold mine/fountain (`js/materials.js`, `js/models_*.js`, `js/models.js`).
- Implemented entity classes, simulation and battle logic (`js/entities.js`, `js/game.js`, `js/combat.js`), AI controller (`js/ai.js`), effects/projectiles (`js/effects.js`), views/health bars/selection rings/live portrait/3D thumbnails (`js/render.js`).
- Implemented camera rig, input/selection/build placement/touch controls, procedural audio (`js/camera.js`, `js/input.js`, `js/audio.js`).
- Wrote full `index.html` menu/HUD/pause/help/end-screen skeleton with Russian UI.
- `js/icons.js` provides inline SVG icons and race crests.

### Active
- `css/style.css` is **not created yet**; `index.html` references it.
- `js/ui.js` is **not created yet**.
- `js/showcase.js` (3D menu diorama) is **not created yet**.
- `js/main.js` is **not created yet**.
- Game has not been run, browser-tested, screenshotted, or debugged.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Create `css/style.css` matching all IDs/classes in `index.html`: dark fantasy gold/blue theme, menu layout with transparent/showcase side, responsive desktop/mobile HUD, command grid, modals, marquee, toasts, floating text, loading screen.
2. Create `js/showcase.js`: Three.js menu scene with three race models on pedestals, lights, slow rotation, hover/select highlighting.
3. Create `js/ui.js`: bind menu race cards/difficulty/start; implement HUD updates, selection portrait via `PortraitRenderer`, command card pages (worker build page, train buttons, queue), minimap drawing/click, toasts, floating text, pause/help/end overlays, victory stats, rematch/menu callbacks.
4. Create `js/main.js`: renderer setup, menu/game state switching, Game/UI/Input/CameraRig wiring, `startGame`/rematch without reloading page (reuse Input via an `attachGame`-style method or rebuild cleanly), animation loop, resize, loading transition.
5. Add missing `InputController` move-mode if desired, ensure desktop right-click and mobile tap orders work; verify `game.completeBuilding` exists (added), queue/supply/AI behavior.
6. Run `start.sh` or the runtime server, open with `playwright-cli`, capture menu and live gameplay screenshots in `screenshots/`, inspect console errors and visuals, fix issues.
7. Commit/push changes if required by workflow.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: complete DOM skeleton; IDs used by upcoming `ui.js`/CSS.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/game.js`: main Game class, spawning, commands, selection, damage/death, update loop.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/combat.js`: unit/building/fountain update logic; imports `game.completeBuilding`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/render.js`: `UnitView`/`BuildingView`/`ResourceView`, `PortraitRenderer`, `iconRenderer`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/input.js`: mouse/touch selection, context orders, build placement, hotkeys; needs UI callbacks.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/ai.js`: AI macro/attack waves.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/data.js`: races, stats, costs, `DIFFICULTY`, `unitDef`, `buildingDef`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/materials.js` + `js/models_*.js` + `js/models.js`: procedural model factories.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/icons.js`: `icon(name)`, `crest(race)` returning SVG strings.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/world.js`: world/terrain setup; exposes `terrainCanvas` for minimap.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/audio.js`: `AudioEngine` SFX/sound toggle.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/js/camera.js`: `CameraRig` with pan/zoom/flyTo/screenToGround.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/three.module.js`: vendored Three.js r170 build.

## Important Context
- Runtime serves static `index.html`; no build step needed.
- `js/main.js` is currently referenced by `index.html` but missing, so the page will 404/blank until created.
- `UI` expected methods referenced by `input.js`: `toast(text,type)`, `refreshCommands()`.
- `InputController` constructor signature: `(renderer, cameraRig, game, ui, audio)`; expose/assign `ui.input` for command buttons.
- `PortraitRenderer` constructor expects a DOM holder, e.g. `#portrait-holder`; `iconRenderer.thumbnail(race, role, isBuilding, teamColor)` returns a data URL.
- `Game` callbacks: `onSelectionChanged(list)`, `onNotify(text,type)`, `onFloatText(worldPos,text,color)`, `onGameOver(winner,teams,time)`, `onStats` (unused).
- Key command APIs: `game.enqueueUnit`, `game.cancelQueue`, `game.assignGather`, `game.orderGather`, `game.orderMove`, `game.orderAttack`, `game.orderStop`, `game.setRally`, `game.startBuilding`, `game.findNearestResource`, `game.unitsOf`, `game.buildingsOf`, `game.getHall`.
- `Game.completeBuilding` was added; `Building.construction` < 1 means under construction; views scale the model accordingly.
- `js/models_undead.js` had a bogus `'cylinder'` mesh removed; avoid reintroducing invalid geometry keys (valid keys are in `GEO` in `js/materials.js`).
- `js/ai.js` imports `RACES` indirectly simplified to `buildingDef`; verify no leftover unused `notifyDefense` harm.
- Browser testing command from project docs: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002`; create `screenshots/` and use `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=...`.

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

## Objective
- Build a polished 3D Warcraft-style RTS browser game with three playable races (Alliance, Horde, Undead) in the empty repo `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround`.

## Requirements
- 3D RTS in Warcraft style with three races; user request is in Russian, so UI/content is Russian.
- Static playable web game served from `index.html`; no external art/audio assets.
- Support desktop and mobile/touch controls; verify with browser screenshots, rejecting blank/loading captures and noting SwiftShader software rendering if used.

## Decisions
- Single-page static HTML/JS app using vendored Three.js (`vendor/three.module.js`); no package project/build step.
- Procedural low-poly models, canvas terrain/minimap, and procedural WebAudio SFX.
- Gameplay: 1v1 duel vs AI, race and difficulty selection, economy (gold/lumber/supply), buildings, units, combat, caster heals, neutral healing fountain, rich central gold mine, control groups, rally points, production queues, win by destroying all enemy halls.
- Architecture split into small ES modules: data, map, nav, entities, game, combat, AI, render/views, effects, world, UI, UI helpers, input, audio, showcase, main.
- CSS split into `style.css` plus imported `menu.css`, `hud.css`, `modals.css` to keep files manageable.
- Menu uses one `Showcase` scene rendered through the main WebGL renderer; game uses separate scene/camera instances per match.
- `PortraitRenderer` and `iconRenderer` add separate WebGL contexts for live portrait and 3D command-card thumbnails.

## Work State
### Completed
- Vendored Three.js `vendor/three.module.js` (three@0.170.0).
- Implemented all race/unit/building stats and difficulty data (`js/data.js`).
- Implemented map layout, procedural terrain/world/lighting/pond/mountains/clouds/grass (`js/map.js`, `js/world.js`), nav grid + A* + smoothing (`js/nav.js`).
- Implemented procedural models for all 15 units and 15 buildings, props, gold mine, fountain (`js/materials.js`, `js/models_*.js`, `js/models.js`).
- Implemented entities, simulation, combat, AI, effects, rendering views, health bars, selection rings, portrait/thumbnail renderers (`js/entities.js`, `js/game.js`, `js/combat.js`, `js/ai.js`, `js/effects.js`, `js/render.js`).
- Implemented camera rig, input/selection/build placement/touch controls, procedural audio (`js/camera.js`, `js/input.js`, `js/audio.js`).
- Wrote full `index.html` menu/HUD/pause/help/end skeleton with Russian UI and inline SVG icon system (`js/icons.js`).
- Created full CSS theme/layout (`css/style.css`, `css/menu.css`, `css/hud.css`, `css/modals.css`), including responsive desktop/mobile layouts and animations.
- Created animated 3D menu diorama with three champions, pedestals, banners, braziers, particles, lighting, and race hover/select highlighting (`js/showcase.js`).
- Created `js/ui_helpers.js` for race detail HTML, selection summaries/stats, cost markup, and victory stats.
- Created `js/ui.js` with menu bindings, HUD updates, live portrait, command card pages, production queue, minimap drawing/click navigation, toasts, floating combat text, pause/help/sound, end screen, rematch/menu callbacks, and keyboard handling.
- Created `js/main.js` with renderer setup, menu/game/loading mode switching, match creation/rematch/return-to-menu, resize handling, and animation loop.
- Added `InputController.dispose()` with stored event handlers and cleanup.
- Fixed terrain generation bug where `ctx.putImageData()` replaced the painterly terrain; noise now blends from a scratch canvas.
- Added `Resource.rich` from spawn options so rich gold mines display correctly.
- Started the runtime development server successfully; it listens on port `3000` (not `3002`) under tmux session `game`.

### Active
- Browser testing/debugging has not yet begun; no screenshots captured or console errors inspected.
- Server log is currently empty; `curl -sI http://localhost:3002` returns nothing because the actual port is `3000`.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
